Description
Returns the name of the current in-scope XML element.
Note: All XML commands are unavailable beginning in v10.
Syntax
XML
::
element
XML::element
Returns the name of the current element.
Examples
when
XML_BEGIN_DOCUMENT
{
XML
::
subscribe
allevent
XML
::
collect
}
when
XML_BEGIN_ELEMENT
{
log
local0.
"Found Element [XML::element]"
}
